why: Open cells are graph nodes connected to their 4 open neighbours; asking whether finish is reachable from start is a BFS (or DFS) on the grid from start.
hints: Treat each open cell as a node. What are its neighbours?
BFS from start over in-bounds open neighbours, marking visited; succeed when you reach finish.
Check both endpoints are open first, then BFS with a deque and a visited matrix. O(rows * cols).
pitfalls: If start or finish is a wall, return false even when start == finish.
start == finish on an open cell is true without moving.
